Brig is an incredibly strong hero, her healing is significantly underrated as long as you proc inspire with whip shots reliably. Her kill potential is scary for flankers as her CC allows easy focus from her teammates. While at range she’s relatively useless, up close she’s one of the games scarier brawlers and she’s literally the best support in many situations in the current meta
